pages_read.title: KEPCO Data Breach Exposes 1.52 Million Records, Including Power Grid Procurement Files

updated.what: Added Seoul Economic Daily as a source. The summary now gives the 1,520,248 simple sum and splits the SRM count into 426,827 procurement participants and 442,934 employees. It adds the climate ministry's statement that power operations are not currently affected. The validation note now has KEPCO's timeline (IP access blocked at 6 a.m. on 20 Nov, PIPC filing at 6:30 p.m. on 22 Nov). The Yonhap sentence about the earlier 35,528-person breach was dropped from the summary for length (it stays in the note), and its evidence entry was removed to keep evidence at 12 or fewer. No published fact changed, so no correction was filed.

open_leads.title: Industry concern that SRM holds procurement data for national grid construction projects
open_leads.note: An unnamed industry official raised a possible energy-security risk. The page does not say that any facility location or equipment data leaked, so it was not added. Watch for an official statement.

notes: The Seoul Economic Daily page is an AI-translated English edition. The quotes in evidence are its English text. The fetch tool limited quotes to 125 characters, but every quote used is a complete sentence or fragment shorter than that.
